query:
SELECT
                    id,
                    status::text AS "status!",
                    run_number,
                    enqueue_request = $4::jsonb AS "enqueue_request_matches?"
                 FROM job_queue
                 WHERE job_type = $1
                   AND organization_id = $2
                   AND idempotency_key = $3
                 LIMIT 1
                 FOR KEY SHARE
